segments.text: Let's jump right into this explainer because today we are going to fundamentally shift
segments.zh: 我们直接进入本期讲解，因为今天我们要从根本上转变

segments.text: your mindset.
segments.zh: 你的思维方式。

segments.text: If you've ever thought about lab safety and immediately pictured safety goggles and a
segments.zh: 如果你一想到实验室安全，脑海里马上浮现的就是安全护目镜和

segments.text: giant box of nitrile gloves, well, you're certainly not alone, but you're actually
segments.zh: 一大盒丁腈手套，嗯，你肯定不是唯一一个这样想的人，但实际上你

segments.text: starting at the absolute wrong end of the equation.
segments.zh: 是从这个问题完全错误的一端开始的。

segments.text: Today we're flipping the lab safety script.
segments.zh: 今天我们要颠覆实验室安全的老剧本。

segments.text: We're moving away from that default just wear gloves approach and getting into what
segments.zh: 我们要摆脱那种默认的“戴上手套就行”的做法，深入了解

segments.text: true structural safety looks like using the hierarchy of controls.
segments.zh: 借助控制层级实现的真正结构性安全是什么样子。

segments.text: You know, just wear gloves is arguably the most dangerous phrase you can utter in a
segments.zh: 你知道，“戴上手套就行”可以说是在实验室里能说出的

segments.text: laboratory.
segments.zh: 最危险的一句话。

segments.text: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.text: Because the hierarchy of controls is absolutely not a casual menu that you just pick and choose
segments.zh: 因为控制层级绝对不是一份可以随意点选、

segments.text: from based on what's convenient.
segments.zh: 按方便程度挑挑拣拣的菜单。

segments.text: It is a strict priority order.
segments.zh: 它是一个严格的优先顺序。

segments.text: When we rely solely on personal protective equipment, we're basically trusting human
segments.zh: 当我们只依赖个人防护装备时，我们基本上是在指望人

segments.text: perfection.
segments.zh: 永远完美。

segments.text: We are betting that a worker won't make a single mistake ever.
segments.zh: 我们是在赌员工永远不会犯任何一个错误。

segments.text: And let's be real, in a high stakes environment, that is the bet we are eventually going to
segments.zh: 说实话，在高风险的环境中，这是一个我们终究会

segments.text: lose.
segments.zh: 输掉的赌注。

segments.text: Okay.
segments.zh: 好。

segments.text: So here's our roadmap for today.
segments.zh: 这是我们今天的路线图。

segments.text: We'll be looking at the inverted pyramid, then elimination and substitution, engineering
segments.zh: 我们会讲倒金字塔，然后是消除和替代、工程

segments.text: controls, administrative controls, and finally PPE as our absolute last line of defense.
segments.zh: 控制、管理控制，最后是作为最后一道防线的个人防护装备。

segments.text: Let's get to it.
segments.zh: 我们开始吧。

segments.text: Starting with section one, the inverted pyramid.
segments.zh: 从第一部分开始，倒金字塔。

segments.text: This is our top down blueprint.
segments.zh: 这是我们自上而下的蓝图。

segments.text: This visualization right here, it's the gold standard published by NIOSH for a very
segments.zh: 这里的这张图，是 NIOSH 发布的黄金标准，这是有充分

segments.text: good reason.
segments.zh: 理由的。

segments.text: It demands a fat top and a narrow bottom.
segments.zh: 它要求上宽下窄。

segments.text: That broad top, we have hazard elimination and those strategies should cover the vast
segments.zh: 在那宽阔的顶部，是消除危害，这些策略应当覆盖我们

segments.text: majority of our risks.
segments.zh: 绝大部分的风险。

segments.text: Then cascading all the way down to that tiny narrow bottom, we have our personal protective
segments.zh: 然后一路往下，到那个窄窄的底部，是我们的个人防护

segments.text: equipment.
segments.zh: 装备。

segments.text: Now this deliberately reverses what most labs actually do in practice, right?
segments.zh: 这恰恰与大多数实验室实际的做法相反，对吧？

segments.text: Which is usually handing out bulk boxes of PPE while severely under investing in those
segments.zh: 他们通常是成箱成箱地发放个人防护装备，而对顶部那些

segments.text: crucial structural controls at the top.
segments.zh: 至关重要的结构性控制却严重投入不足。

segments.text: The core difference we're looking at here really boils down to one word, reliability.
segments.zh: 我们在这里看到的核心区别，归结起来就是一个词：可靠性。

segments.text: The higher you go up this pyramid, the less it matters if a worker makes a mistake.
segments.zh: 在这个金字塔上越往上走，员工犯不犯错就越不重要。

segments.text: Those higher levels literally eliminate the hazard entirely, regardless of human
segments.zh: 那些较高层级的措施实实在在地彻底消除了危害，无论人的

segments.text: behavior.
segments.zh: 行为如何。

segments.text: Lower levels, on the other hand, rely completely on perfect human compliance,
segments.zh: 而较低层级则完全依赖于人完美地遵守规定、

segments.text: perfect fit, and perfect maintenance.
segments.zh: 完美的贴合度和完美的维护。

segments.text: If you're tired, if you're rushed, or just distracted for a second, a lower level
segments.zh: 如果你累了、赶时间，或者只是走神了一秒钟，较低层级的

segments.text: control will fail you, for sure.
segments.zh: 控制肯定会让你失望。

segments.text: Moving right along to section two, elimination and substitution.
segments.zh: 接下来是第二部分，消除和替代。

segments.text: These are your highest leverage controls.
segments.zh: 这些是你杠杆效应最大的控制措施。

segments.text: Think about a pharmaceutical analytical method that relies on for bromo aniline,
segments.zh: 想象一个制药分析方法，它依赖于 4-溴苯胺，

segments.text: which is a suspected carcinogen.
segments.zh: 这是一种疑似致癌物。

segments.text: Now, instead of just buying everyone fancy or respirators, they completely redesigned
segments.zh: 他们没有给每个人买昂贵的呼吸器，而是彻底重新设计了

segments.text: the method to remove that chemical from the workflow entirely.
segments.zh: 这个方法，把这种化学品完全从工作流程中去掉。

segments.text: Sure, it took six months to validate the new method, but it ended a 25-year exposure
segments.zh: 没错，验证新方法花了六个月，但它一夜之间就终结了长达 25 年的暴露

segments.text: pattern literally overnight.
segments.zh: 模式。

segments.text: It's simple logic.
segments.zh: 道理很简单。

segments.text: If the hazard isn't there, it simply cannot harm you.
segments.zh: 如果危害不存在，它就根本不可能伤害你。

segments.text: Now, of course, complete elimination isn't always scientifically possible.
segments.zh: 当然，完全消除在科学上并不总是可行的。

segments.text: When that happens, we substitute.
segments.zh: 这种情况下，我们就进行替代。

segments.text: Pfizer's redesign of their Zoloft synthesis is a massive success story for this.
segments.zh: 辉瑞对其左洛复合成工艺的重新设计就是这方面的一个巨大成功案例。

segments.text: By applying green chemistry principles and swapping out hazardous solvents for
segments.zh: 通过应用绿色化学原则，把危险溶剂换成

segments.text: safer alternatives, they didn't just improve safety on the floor.
segments.zh: 更安全的替代品，他们不仅改善了车间的安全。

segments.text: They actually achieved a massive 70% reduction in waste.
segments.zh: 实际上还实现了废物量大幅减少 70%。

segments.text: So safety and sustainability perfectly aligned.
segments.zh: 安全与可持续性完美契合。

segments.text: A real win-win.
segments.zh: 真正的双赢。

segments.text: The absolute crucial takeaway here is that substitution is a rigorous,
segments.zh: 这里最关键的要点是，替代是一个严谨的、

segments.text: structured decision.
segments.zh: 结构化的决策。

segments.text: It is not just some wishful thought or a quick swap.
segments.zh: 它不是一厢情愿的想法，也不是随手一换。

segments.text: You don't just guess.
segments.zh: 你不能靠猜。

segments.text: You have to identify the hazard, find candidate substitutes, compare their
segments.zh: 你必须识别危害，找出候选替代品，比较它们的

segments.text: toxicological profiles, assess the feasibility and cost, and then run a pilot
segments.zh: 毒理学特征，评估可行性和成本，然后进行小规模试点，

segments.text: to validate the whole thing before implementing it with proper change control.
segments.zh: 对整个方案进行验证，再通过适当的变更控制加以实施。

segments.text: You've got to run the framework to make sure you aren't just trading one known
segments.zh: 你必须走完这个框架，以确保你不是在用一种已知的

segments.text: hazard for a completely new, unexpected one.
segments.zh: 危害换来一种全新的、意想不到的危害。

segments.text: Dropping down to section three, engineering controls.
segments.zh: 往下到第三部分，工程控制。

segments.text: This is all about isolating the hazard.
segments.zh: 这完全是关于隔离危害。

segments.text: So when we can't remove or substitute the hazard, we have to isolate it.
segments.zh: 所以，当我们无法消除或替代危害时，就必须把它隔离起来。

segments.text: We use physical means that are totally independent of worker behavior.
segments.zh: 我们使用完全不依赖于员工行为的物理手段。

segments.text: A chemical fume hood, for example, when operating correctly at a face velocity
segments.zh: 例如，化学通风柜在以每分钟 80 到 120 英尺的面风速

segments.text: of 80 to 120 feet per minute, perfectly captures dangerous vapors right at the source.
segments.zh: 正常运行时，能在源头完美地捕集危险蒸气。

segments.text: Biological safety cabinets and glove boxes do the exact same thing.
segments.zh: 生物安全柜和手套箱的作用也完全一样。

segments.text: These physical barriers are the scalable workhorses of the lab.
segments.zh: 这些物理屏障是实验室里可大规模应用的主力。

segments.text: They capture hazard perfectly, regardless of whether a chemist happened to
segments.zh: 无论化学人员那天早上碰巧有没有记住安全规定，

segments.text: remember the safety rules that morning.
segments.zh: 它们都能完美地捕集危害。

segments.text: They're durable and they're highly reliable.
segments.zh: 它们经久耐用，而且高度可靠。

segments.text: Down to section four now, administrative controls.
segments.zh: 现在往下到第四部分，管理控制。

segments.text: Here, we're looking at process and behavior.
segments.zh: 在这里，我们关注的是流程和行为。

segments.text: These controls are entirely about modifying human behavior.
segments.zh: 这些控制措施完全在于改变人的行为。

segments.text: We're talking about detailed standard operating procedures, requiring prior
segments.zh: 我们说的是详细的标准操作程序、扩大反应规模前

segments.text: approvals for scaling up a reaction, time of day scheduling so that high-risk
segments.zh: 须事先审批、按时段安排工作，使高风险

segments.text: work only ever happens when full emergency staff is actually in the
segments.zh: 作业只在全部应急人员都在

segments.text: building, and buddy systems.
segments.zh: 大楼里时进行，以及同伴制度。

segments.text: But, and this is a big but, because they modify human behavior, their
segments.zh: 但是，这是一个很大的“但是”，由于它们改变的是人的行为，它们的

segments.text: reliability rests heavily on supervision and compliance.
segments.zh: 可靠性在很大程度上取决于监督和遵守情况。

segments.text: And as we all know, humans aren't exactly flawless robots, especially
segments.zh: 而我们都知道，人并不是完美无缺的机器人，尤其是

segments.text: before their morning coffee.
segments.zh: 在早上喝咖啡之前。

segments.text: Safely executing complex tasks like handling pyrophoric regions takes
segments.zh: 在这个层级上，要安全地完成像处理自燃性试剂这样的复杂任务，

segments.text: constant, unyielding vigilance at this level.
segments.zh: 需要持续不懈的警惕。

segments.text: And finally, section five, PPE, the absolute last line of defense.
segments.zh: 最后，第五部分，个人防护装备，最后一道防线。

segments.text: You know, that default assumption of just handing out standard nitrile
segments.zh: 你知道，那种默认给每个进门的人都发一副标准丁腈

segments.text: gloves to everyone who walks in the door is dangerously incomplete.
segments.zh: 手套的做法，是危险而不完整的。

segments.text: Just look at the data.
segments.zh: 看看这些数据。

segments.text: Nitrile is great for incidental contact, sure, but it degrades really
segments.zh: 丁腈手套用于偶然接触确实不错，但遇到酮类它会

segments.text: quickly against ketones.
segments.zh: 很快降解。

segments.text: Latex, it might be a decent biological barrier, but it's pretty
segments.zh: 乳胶手套也许是不错的生物屏障，但对大多数化学品来说

segments.text: terrible against most chemicals.
segments.zh: 相当糟糕。

segments.text: And then butyl rubber is excellent for ketones, but basically
segments.zh: 而丁基橡胶手套对酮类非常好，但对烃类

segments.text: useless against hydrocarbons.
segments.zh: 基本上毫无用处。

segments.text: You literally have to match the specific glove material to the
segments.zh: 你必须让具体的手套材料与

segments.text: specific chemical hazard.
segments.zh: 具体的化学危害相匹配。

segments.text: It is not one size fits all.
segments.zh: 不存在一刀切的方案。

segments.text: Let's ground this all in a real, incredibly sobering scenario.
segments.zh: 我们用一个真实的、令人警醒的场景来说明这一切。

segments.text: Imagine a graduate student who's handling a new fluorinated reactive
segments.zh: 想象一名研究生正在处理一种新的含氟活性

segments.text: intermediate.
segments.zh: 中间体。

segments.text: By all accounts, they're doing everything seemingly right.
segments.zh: 从各方面看，他似乎做得一切都对。

segments.text: They're working in a certified fume hood, and they faithfully wear
segments.zh: 他在一台经过认证的通风柜里操作，而且六周来每天都

segments.text: their standard nitrile gloves every single day for six weeks.
segments.zh: 认真戴着标准丁腈手套。

segments.text: They feel absolutely no skin contact, no burning sensation,
segments.zh: 他完全没有感觉到皮肤接触，没有灼烧感，

segments.text: and they report zero symptoms.
segments.zh: 也没有报告任何症状。

segments.text: So given what we literally just saw about chemical compatibility,
segments.zh: 那么，根据我们刚才看到的化学相容性情况，

segments.text: we really have to ask, did this baseline rule actually protect
segments.zh: 我们真的要问一问，这条基本规则真的保护了

segments.text: the student?
segments.zh: 这名学生吗？

segments.text: Was throwing on generic PPE enough to prevent a silent dermal
segments.zh: 随便戴上通用的个人防护装备，足以防止无声无息的皮肤

segments.text: exposure?
segments.zh: 暴露吗？

segments.text: The shocking reality here is no, not at all.
segments.zh: 令人震惊的现实是：不，完全不能。

segments.text: The chemical permeated that nitrile glove in under 30
segments.zh: 这种化学品在不到 30 分钟内

segments.text: minutes.
segments.zh: 就渗透了丁腈手套。

segments.text: And because the breakthrough was completely silent and painless,
segments.zh: 而且由于渗透完全是无声无息、毫无痛感的，

segments.text: it actually led to a severe elevation in the student's
segments.zh: 它实际上导致这名学生的肝酶

segments.text: liver enzymes, which was only discovered during a routine
segments.zh: 严重升高，而这只是在一次例行

segments.text: medical screening.
segments.zh: 体检中才被发现的。

segments.text: This perfectly, perfectly illustrates the severe
segments.zh: 这完美地、完美地说明了只依赖

segments.text: limitations and physical vulnerabilities of relying
segments.zh: 默认个人防护装备的严重局限性

segments.text: solely on default PPE.
segments.zh: 和物理上的脆弱性。

segments.text: A simple specialty glove worn underneath the nitrile would
segments.zh: 只要在丁腈手套里面戴一副简单的专用手套，本可以

segments.text: have completely prevented this, but the initial hazard
segments.zh: 完全避免这一切，但最初的危害

segments.text: assessment just failed them.
segments.zh: 评估让他们失望了。

segments.text: To prevent devastating tragedies like the UCLA Sanji case
segments.zh: 为了防止像 UCLA Sangji 案那样涉及高活性材料的

segments.text: involving highly reactive materials,
segments.zh: 毁灭性悲剧，

segments.text: we absolutely must use what's known as a Swiss cheese
segments.zh: 我们绝对必须采用所谓的瑞士奶酪式

segments.text: layered approach.
segments.zh: 多层防护方法。

segments.text: Look, every single layer of protection has holes in it.
segments.zh: 你看，每一层防护都有漏洞。

segments.text: But if you substitute a safer surrogate where possible,
segments.zh: 但如果你在可能的情况下换用更安全的替代物，

segments.text: and then use a glove box for engineering isolation,
segments.zh: 然后用手套箱进行工程隔离，

segments.text: enforce a buddy system administratively,
segments.zh: 在管理上执行同伴制度，

segments.text: and wear a flame resistant coat as your final PPE,
segments.zh: 再穿上阻燃实验服作为最后的个人防护装备，

segments.text: well, if one of those layers fails,
segments.zh: 那么，即使其中一层失效了，

segments.text: the next layer is right there to catch the hazard.
segments.zh: 下一层也会立刻接住危害。

segments.text: Which brings us to our final thought for this explainer.
segments.zh: 这就引出了本期讲解的最后一点思考。

segments.text: I want you to take a really hard look at your own daily lab
segments.zh: 我希望你认真审视一下自己每天的实验室

segments.text: routine and ask yourself, if your primary safety measure
segments.zh: 日常，问问自己：如果你的主要安全措施

segments.text: fails today, right now, do you
segments.zh: 今天、就在此刻失效了，你

segments.text: have a higher level control already in place
segments.zh: 是否已经有一个更高层级的控制措施

segments.text: to catch that hazard?
segments.zh: 来拦住这个危害？

segments.text: Or are you truly just waiting for a routine human error
segments.zh: 还是说，你真的只是在等着一个寻常的人为失误

segments.text: to completely bypass your only line of defense?
segments.zh: 彻底绕过你唯一的那道防线？

segments.text: Thanks for joining me today.
segments.zh: 感谢你今天的收看。

segments.text: Stay safe out there, and start building your pyramid
segments.zh: 注意安全，开始搭建你的金字塔，

segments.text: from the top down.
segments.zh: 从顶层往下搭建。
